title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder - 18-Inch Solid Brass with Weighted Base (Traditional Style) | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your countertop with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass, featuring an 18-inch height and a weighted base to help keep rolls steady without wall mounting.

  • Freestanding design: requires no wall mounting
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Stability: solid brass weighted base helps prevent tipping
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching on countertops and other surfaces
  • Finish options: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs

  • Material: Brass
  • Style: Traditional (elegant, timeless, refined, luxurious)
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Dimensions: 5.5 in L x 5.5 in W x 18 in H
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Designed to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures-inspired spaces.

_previous.title: Traditional Counter Top Kitchen Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Complete your kitchen décor with this finely crafted counter top paper towel holder. Keep your counter top clutter free while adding the finishing touch to your space. Made of solid brass and provided with a lifetime finish to insure products will never rust.
